rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for privacy, especially in discussions of personal life or personal information.

example.english: We respect your privacy and won't make your information public.
example.traditional: 我哋會尊重你嘅私隱，唔會將你嘅資料公開。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zyun1 zung6 nei5 ge3 si1 jan2 m4 wui5 zoeng1 nei5 ge3 zi1 liu6 gung1 hoi1

rows.note: Use this mainly in written or formal contexts for the protection of personal information from public scrutiny or disclosure.

example.english: Websites must not disclose users' privacy without consent.
example.traditional: 網站不得未經同意公開用戶嘅隱私。
example.jyutping: mong5 zaam6 bat1 dak1 mei6 ging1 tung4 ji3 gung1 hoi1 jung6 wu6 ge3 jan2 si1

rows.note: Use this for having physical or personal space away from other people.

example.english: I want to be alone for a bit; give me some privacy.
example.traditional: 我想一個人靜下，畀我少少私人空間。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jat1 go3 jan4 zing6 haa5 bei2 ngo5 siu2 siu2 si1 jan4 hung1 gaan1
